reason: This is a broad cross-cutting refactor of the `sqlexec`/`sessionctx` boundary that touches core executor, planner-context, session, privilege, and statistics paths. Even if framed as dependency cleanup, changing these interfaces in `pkg/session/session.go`, `pkg/sessionctx/context.go`, `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go`, multiple executor entrypoints, privilege cache, and auto-analyze code is central enough to risk executor/runtime correctness, session behavior, restricted-SQL behavior, and stats maintenance regressions.
